QuestInfo.name: The Shelter Key
QuestInfo.1: The Policeman in the year 2099 mentioned that #b#eCaptain Edmond#k#n is still in the harbor somewhere. He asked you to find the #b #i4032514##t4032514##k and deliver it to the captain. The #bOverlord As#k and #bOverlord Bs#k most likely have it.
QuestInfo.2: The Policeman you met at Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 asked you to find the Shelter Key and deliver it to Captain Edmond. You retrieved the key from the monsters and gave it to Captain Edmond at the quayside.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 468,451\nCan proceed to Temporary Relief quest\n
QuestInfo.0: #p2082007# has a favor to ask of you. Go find out what it is.

0.0: Could I ask you for one last favor? Everyone at the harbor was evacuated except one person. His name is Captain Edmond. He's stubborn and wouldn't cooperate. I think he remained behind, somewhere at the harbor. I must deliver the Shelter Key to him. Will you help me?

yes.0: There's another problem. I've lost the Shelter Key that Captain Edmond gave me. I'm certain one of the robots took it when I dropped it. Could you find the #b #i4032514##t4032514##k by taking out #bOverlord As and Overlord Bs#k? When you find the key, take it to #b#eCaptain Edmond#k#n.

no.0: I'm so worried about the captain. He's all alone right now.

1.0: What is it? What brings you here?\r\n#b#L0#I've come to give you the Shelter Key. It's dangerous here.#l\n#k
1.1: Nonsense! I'm fine. But I'll take the key.

npc.0: Get the Shelter Key from the monsters, and take that to Captain Edmond. He should be somewhere in the harbor.

item.0: I have figure out how to get rid of the monsters in the harbor, so don't bother me!
